references.text: God says to Moses 'I am who I am', which is a connection to Jesus' statement 'egō eimi' (I am)
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me, which resonates with 'mὴ φοβεῖσθε' (do not be afraid)
But he said to them, It is I, do not be afraid; a direct parallel to Jesus' words in Matthew 14:27
